title: BTS Closes Out Las Vegas ARIRANG World Tour Residency — Night 4 Completes Four-Night, ~260,000-Fan Run at Allegiant Stadium
detail: BTS performs Night 4 of their sold-out ARIRANG World Tour Las Vegas residency at Allegiant Stadium on May 28, 2026, completing a historic four-night run (Nights 1–2: May 23–24; Nights 3–4: May 27–28) that drew approximately 260,000 fans across all dates. The four nights sold out in 23 minutes when tickets went on sale, making BTS the fastest act to sell out Allegiant Stadium. The ~2.5-hour, ~20-song set features the full ARIRANG album performed in sequence alongside catalog favorites and rotating night-specific surprise songs. The 360-degree in-the-round stage, designed with a 'jeongja' pavilion motif inspired by Gyeonghoeru Pavilion at Gyeongbokgung Palace, transforms the 65,000-capacity venue with traditional Korean music interludes woven throughout. The Las Vegas leg featured a city-wide activation: BTS pop-up at The Forum Shops at Caesars Palace, BTS-branded Las Vegas Monorail cars, fireworks over MGM Grand, and an immersive art experience in the Arts District. With the Las Vegas residency concluded, the ARIRANG World Tour — BTS's first full-group stadium tour since completing South Korea's mandatory military service, spanning 85+ dates across 34 cities in 23 countries and billed as the largest stadium tour in K-pop history — moves to Busan, South Korea for anniversary-period shows on June 12–13, followed by the European leg in July (Brussels, London, Munich, Paris).
